text: Hello and welcome to Real Easy English,
zh: 大家好,欢迎收听《Real Easy English》,
zh_hant: 大家好,歡迎收聽《Real Easy English》,

text: the podcast where we have real conversations
zh: 在这个播客里,我们用简单的英语
zh_hant: 在這個播客裡,我們用簡單的英語

text: in easy English to help you learn.
zh: 进行真实的对话,帮助你学习。
zh_hant: 進行真實的對話,幫助你學習。

text: I'm Georgie.
And I'm Neil.
To watch a video version
zh: 如果想观看这个播客的视频版
zh_hant: 如果想觀看這個播客的影片版

text: of this podcast and download a free worksheet,
go to our website - bbclearningenglish.com.
Hi, Neil, how are you?
Are you happy to be at work today?
zh: 你今天在这儿工作开心吗?
zh_hant: 你今天在這兒工作開心嗎?

text: Of course.
I'm always happy to be at work.
Great.
Well, today we are talking about dream jobs.
zh: 今天我们要聊聊梦想的工作。
zh_hant: 今天我們要聊聊夢想的工作。

text: Obviously, this job is amazing,
zh: 很明显,这份工作已经很棒了,
zh_hant: 很明顯,這份工作已經很棒了,

text: but we're going to talk about some different jobs we'd like to do.
zh: 但我们要聊聊我们想做的其他工作。
zh_hant: 但我們要聊聊我們想做的其他工作。

text: Sounds good.
Shall we start?
Yes.
So, Georgie, when you were a child,
what did you want to do when you grew up?
What was your dream job?
Well, when I was really little , about five or six.
zh: 嗯,我很小的时候,大概五六岁吧。
zh_hant: 嗯,我很小的時候,大概五六歲吧。

text: I remember telling people that I wanted to be a princess.
zh: 我记得跟别人说我想当公主。
zh_hant: 我記得跟別人說我想當公主。

text: When I realised that wasn't going to be possible for me,
zh: 当我意识到这不可能实现后,
zh_hant: 當我意識到這不可能實現後,

text: my next dream was to be a pop star,
zh: 我的下一个梦想是成为流行歌星,
zh_hant: 我的下一個夢想是成為流行歌星,

text: because my friends and I used to write songs
zh: 因为我和朋友们经常写歌
zh_hant: 因為我和朋友們經常寫歌

text: and perform in front of our parents,
and I thought that would be really fun.
Yeah.
What about you?
Well, I'm kind of similar.
I think, actually,
when I was, when I was a child ,
I thought that being a professional sportsman
would be fantastic.
Either a footballer or a cricketer.
zh: 要么是足球运动员,要么是板球运动员。
zh_hant: 要麼是足球運動員,要麼是板球運動員。

text: What went wrong?
I'm not good enough.
I learned that lesson.
So, Neil, obviously you are not a rock star.
zh: 那么,Neil,显然你没成为摇滚明星。
zh_hant: 那麼,Neil,顯然你沒成為搖滾明星。

text: But how or when did you decide to become an English
zh: 但你是怎么或什么时候决定
zh_hant: 但你是怎麼或什麼時候決定

text: teacher
instead?
Well, when I finished university,
I wanted to travel more than anything else.
zh: 最想做的事就是去旅行。
zh_hant: 最想做的事就是去旅行。

text: And I wanted to live in foreign countries,
not just go on holiday.
And I thought a good way to do that would be to become an English teacher.
zh: 我觉得当英语老师是实现这个愿望的好办法。
zh_hant: 我覺得當英語老師是實現這個願望的好辦法。

text: Yeah, I have a similar story.
zh: 是啊,我的经历也差不多。
zh_hant: 是啊,我的經歷也差不多。

text: It was the same thing for me.
I just wanted to live abroad.
Georgie, what is important to you about your job now?
zh: Georgie,你现在的工作对你来说最重要的是什么?
zh_hant: Georgie,你現在的工作對你來說最重要的是什麼?

text: Well, many of us spend a lot of our lives working.
zh: 嗯,我们很多人一生中大部分时间都在工作。
zh_hant: 嗯,我們很多人一生中大部分時間都在工作。

text: So for me, it's really important
to enjoy the day.
zh: 享受每一天真的很重要。
zh_hant: 享受每一天真的很重要。

text: We work nine to five.
It's a lot of hours in the day.
It's really important to me
to have a nice team that you can have fun with.
zh: 要有一个能一起开心相处的团队。
zh_hant: 要有一個能一起開心相處的團隊。

text: It's also really important
for me to feel like
I'm giving something
good or doing a good job.
zh: 好的东西,或者做得不错。
zh_hant: 好的東西,或者做得不錯。

text: What about you?
Yeah.
I think it's important
to feel that you're doing something useful.
zh: 感觉自己在做有用的事情。
zh_hant: 感覺自己在做有用的事情。

text: So hopefully our conversations
zh: 所以希望我们这样的对话
zh_hant: 所以希望我們這樣的對話

text: like this are useful for people
because they can learn something,
zh: 因为他们能从中学到东西,
zh_hant: 因為他們能從中學到東西,

text: and I like that.
Yeah.
Me too.
So, Neil, if you didn't have to worry about money
zh: 那么,Neil,如果你不用担心钱
zh_hant: 那麼,Neil,如果你不用擔心錢

text: or anything else,
what would your dream job be?
zh: 你的梦想工作会是什么?
zh_hant: 你的夢想工作會是什麼?

text: I think I know the answer already.
zh: 我想我已经知道答案了。
zh_hant: 我想我已經知道答案了。

text: Yeah, well, you said earlier
that I didn't become a rock star,
but there is still a future.
And, you know, if I didn't have to work ,
zh: 而且,你知道的,如果我不用工作,
zh_hant: 而且,你知道的,如果我不用工作,

text: I could just follow my dream.
zh: 我就可以去追随我的梦想。
zh_hant: 我就可以去追隨我的夢想。

text: How about you?
I think
if I didn't do this job ,
zh: 如果我不做现在这份工作,
zh_hant: 如果我不做現在這份工作,

text: I would like to be a travel photographer
zh: 我想成为一名旅行摄影师,
zh_hant: 我想成為一名旅行攝影師,

text: or someone
that makes documentaries.
I really love those nature documentaries,
zh: 我真的很喜欢那些自然纪录片,
zh_hant: 我真的很喜歡那些自然紀錄片,

text: and it would be very fun to be involved in those.
zh: 能参与其中一定很有趣。
zh_hant: 能參與其中一定很有趣。

text: Yes, that sounds like it would be amazing.
zh: 是啊,那听起来一定很棒。
zh_hant: 是啊,那聽起來一定很棒。

text: OK, let's recap the language we heard during the conversation.
zh: 好了,让我们回顾一下对话中出现的语言点。
zh_hant: 好了,讓我們回顧一下對話中出現的語言點。

text: We talked about our dream jobs
zh: 我们用“当我还小的时候,
zh_hant: 我們用“當我還小的時候,

text: when we were children using the structure when I was younger,
I wanted to be...
zh: 聊了我们小时候的梦想职业。
zh_hant: 聊了我們小時候的夢想職業。

text: So, for example, when I was younger, I wanted to be a footballer.
zh: 比如说,当我还小的时候,我想成为一名足球运动员。
zh_hant: 比如說,當我還小的時候,我想成為一名足球運動員。

text: And we talked about our dream jobs now using conditionals.
zh: 我们还用条件句聊了现在的梦想职业。
zh_hant: 我們還用條件句聊了現在的夢想職業。

text: So for example, if I could do any job ,
zh: 比如说,如果我能做任何工作,
zh_hant: 比如說,如果我能做任何工作,

text: I would be a travel photographer.
zh: 我会成为一名旅行摄影师。
zh_hant: 我會成為一名旅行攝影師。

text: And when we're talking about jobs,
we can do them, or we can be them.
zh: 可以说“做”这份工作,也可以说“是”这个身份。
zh_hant: 可以說“做”這份工作,也可以說“是”這個身份。

text: For example, I teach English,
or I am an English teacher.
zh: 或者,我是一名英语老师。
zh_hant: 或者,我是一名英語老師。

text: And that's it for this episode of Real Easy English.
zh: 这就是本期《Real Easy English》的全部内容。
zh_hant: 這就是本期《Real Easy English》的全部內容。

text: If you like our programmes, why not sign up to our email newsletter?
zh: 如果你喜欢我们的节目,不如订阅我们的邮件通讯吧?
zh_hant: 如果你喜歡我們的節目,不如訂閱我們的郵件通訊吧?

text: You can get suggestions for other English lessons you might enjoy.
zh: 你可以获得其他你可能感兴趣的英语课程推荐。
zh_hant: 你可以獲得其他你可能感興趣的英語課程推薦。

text: There's a link in the notes for this programme.
zh: 节目说明里有相关链接。
zh_hant: 節目說明裡有相關連結。

text: Next time we'll talk about lunch.
Join us again.
Bye.
